main.description: Create a Workspace owned by the caller. The caller becomes the space authority — createSpace makes the caller the authority and offers no way to do otherwise — which is why only the creator can manage members afterwards. The caller must be an active cluster member; that gate lives here rather than in the protocol, because nothing reserves this space type to SCN. A new Workspace has exactly one member, the creator, added automatically by the runtime. The returned id is the space's skey and is the Workspace's durable identity: store that, never the uri, because the authority DID cannot be transferred and the at:// versus ats:// scheme is unsettled upstream.

displayName.description: What members see. Not an identity — two Workspaces may share a name, and creation is not deduplicated on it.

id.description: The stable Workspace ID: a TID, and the space's skey. The durable name for this Workspace in every other system.

uri.description: The space URI as it stands today. A live address, not an identity — it is a projection of (authority DID, type, skey) and there is no uri column behind it. Re-read it; do not store it.
